output.headline: send_email has no idempotency key, so timeout retries can send duplicate emails to customers.
what_happens: Refund completes, and the agent sends a confirmation email as instructed.
The email call times out after 8-15s but returns delivered:true anyway.
Seeing an error, the agent retries the same call verbatim.
Without a declared idempotency key, the retry sometimes creates a brand-new email, duplicating the send.
output.why_it_matters: This happens every time on this path since the timeout and success-shaped error body are structural, and the same unguarded retry pattern risks duplicate refund_execute calls, i.e. duplicate money movement.
output.fix_in_one_line: Add a required, server-enforced idempotency_key to send_email (and refund_execute) and stop returning success fields alongside timeout errors.

notes: Captured from a live run triggered in the browser.
